summary:
ASTRA (Astronaut Space Health Monitoring System) is an intelligent web-based platform designed to support astronaut health and well-being during space missions. Space environments can significantly affect human health due to microgravity, isolation, radiation exposure, and changes in daily routines.

ASTRA provides a centralized health monitoring dashboard to track important health parameters, visualize health trends, and identify potential health concerns. It includes interactive health analytics, daily health checklists, alerts, and an AI-powered Flight Surgeon chatbot that provides health-related information and guidance.

The platform aims to make astronaut health monitoring more accessible, organized, and efficient by combining health data visualization with AI-assisted support. ASTRA demonstrates how modern web technologies and artificial intelligence can contribute to astronaut safety, preventive healthcare, and better decision-making during long-duration space missions
details:
ASTRA (Astronaut Space Health Monitoring System) is an intelligent, AI-powered web application designed to support astronaut health monitoring during space missions.

Space missions expose astronauts to challenging environments that can affect their physical and mental well-being. ASTRA aims to address this challenge by providing a centralized platform to monitor astronaut health, visualize vital health information, track wellness trends, and support health-related decision-making.

The platform includes an interactive health dashboard, vital-sign monitoring, health trend visualization, daily health tracking, an alert system, and an AI-powered Flight Surgeon Assistant designed to provide health-related information and assistance.

ASTRA is developed using modern web technologies, including React.js, JavaScript, Node.js, and related web development tools. AI capabilities are integrated to enhance the user experience and provide intelligent assistance.

The main innovation of ASTRA is bringing astronaut health information, AI-assisted support, and health visualization together in one accessible platform. It aims to improve health awareness, support early identification of potential health concerns, and contribute to safer and more sustainable human space exploration.

Our vision is to make astronaut healthcare smarter, more accessible, and more efficient for future space missions.
